On a morning of low fog he found a green bottle wedged between the rocks below the tower. The cork was soft with salt. Inside lay a page folded small, the ink blurred but readable. It said only: We saw your light last night and turned toward it. Thank you. Tomas read it three times. No ship had been reported near the point. He climbed the stairs, wiped the lens as he did every dawn, and for the first time wrote an extra line in the logbook: Someone was here.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没醒透。路灯在空荡的街口投下昏黄的光，环卫工人的扫帚声一下一下刮过地面。早点铺掀开蒸笼，白气升进冷空气里。远处高架桥上偶尔驶过一辆夜班公交，车窗里坐着几个打盹的人。写字楼只剩零星几扇窗亮着，像没睡着的眼睛。风带着潮湿的凉意，吹过空旷的广场。天边裂开一道淡青色的缝，新的一天正悄悄逼近。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Picture a set of nesting dolls: you open one and find a smaller doll, and you keep going until you reach the tiny one that does not open.\n- That tiny doll is the stopping point, and without it the opening would never end."}
